content.title: MongoDB Stock Has Been Rising. Can a New CEO Keep the Momentum Up?
content.summary: Database software maker MongoDB on Monday said it would soon welcome a new CEO and said it expected third-quarter results would exceed its prior guidance.

thumbnail.caption: David Paul Morris / Bloomberg via Getty Images Dev Ittycheria (pictured) will step down as CEO of MongoDB next week after 11 years leading the company.

content.title: MongoDB Stock Gains After Naming Cloudflare Exec Next CEO, Publishing Early Q3 Results
content.summary: MongoDB stock rallied but then gave back some of those gains after announcing a new CEO and preliminary quarterly results.

content.title: MongoDB taps Cloudflare executive Chirantan Desai as CEO
content.summary: Desai will succeed Dev Ittycheria, who is stepping down after more than 11 years leading the company.  Shares of MongoDB rose 5% following the announcement.  Desai, a veteran technology executive with over 25 years of experience, previously also held senior roles at ServiceNow, EMC, Symantec and Oracle.

In this dynamic environment, identifying high-growth tech stocks involves looking for companies that can capitalize on technological advancements and maintain robust growth despite potential economic headwinds.
